name: Set PR Reviewer
script:
# Resolve the GitHub reviewer username (from the webhook payload) to a Frappe
# User via Frappe Agile Settings > Development Team, then store it on the Work Item.
# Safe to run even when no reviewer is present (e.g. on pull_request:opened).
if reviewer_github_login:
    reviewer = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Development Team Member",
        {"parent": "Frappe Agile Settings", "github_username": reviewer_github_login},
        "user",
    )
    if reviewer:
        frappe.db.set_value("Work Item", context_docname, "pr_reviewer_user", reviewer)
